title: Shadowfax to acquire WeFast for Rs 23.3 crore to enter on-demand intra-city logistics
summary: Shadowfax acquires WeFast for Rs 23.3 crore to enter intra-city logistics
detailed: WeFast, founded in 2016, operates in more than five cities, where its over 32,000 delivery partners complete more than 12 million deliveries a year. The company generated about Rs 200 crore in adjusted revenue in calendar year 2025, according to the filing.
